summary: Phase I-2 installer for the image edition of the immutable Nex Core plan: nex-image-install.sh runs the static nex-hostimage inside Debian Installer (S7: keep d-i), nex-config emits layout=single|raid1 and the disk list with a 24 GiB floor, UEFI-only refusal and Repair image mode (text wizard), and installer/netinst-manifest.py generalises to payloads.tsv rows for the signed image, the Controller appliance and the VirtIO ISO, placed under /var/lib/nex/payload/<sha256>/. The Classic edition stays selectable.

guide.reason: Install page gains the image edition section; Repair image has its own page.

api.reason: Installer and media only; no Controller, host or peer API changes.

roadmap.reason: Phase I-2 of a proposed, not yet authorized plan.

state.reason: The installer keeps no state; the installed host's disks are the record.
state.record: GPT partition names (nex-esp, nex-root-a/b, nex-verity-a/b, nex-data), nex-data contents under /var/lib/nex (etc upper, payload/<sha256>/). A fresh Controller recovers everything through host APIs.

verification.method: tests/test_image_installer.py and tests/test_netinst.py unit tests (the installer script run against fake tools: verification precedes any array stop or write, only the selected disks' arrays are stopped, the data mirror is assembled from its own members, a damaged media payload stops the install, and the serial menu entries are labelled Classic on image media), tests/integration/installer-handoff.py (the hook clears no disk before the image installer runs), installer/check.sh, and a retained earlier d-i boot log for S7. No ISO was built and no image install was booted in QEMU: that is outstanding.
